subject: [PATCH nfs-utils v3 00/11] mountd: bugfixes for up/downcall interfaces

2026-09-15.patch_summary: This patch series addresses several bugs and issues in the mountd interface of the nfs-utils package, specifically related to up/downcall interfaces. The patches fix problems reported by Mantas, Sashiko, and others, including warnings about internal events, unexportable paths, and submounts nobody asked to export. The changes also include cleanup of warning messages, retrying transient failures, dropping deferred requests, and bounding junction path lengths. Overall, the patch series aims to improve the stability and reliability of the mountd interface.

reviews.author: Steve Dickson
reviews.summary: Reviewer Steve Dickson noted that the patch was already committed and tagged in nfs-utils-2-9-3-rc6, making further review unnecessary.
